Definition: Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Rehoboth is a city Asshur built in the old world, and the well Isaac dug when the strife was over, saying, for now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land. A king of Edom also came from Rehoboth by the river.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that God makes room where men have made none, and Isaac's well is the proof of it.
